statement: Build a one-page, mobile-first website for Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, that shows the menu with prices, opening hours and location, and lets visitors pre-order for pickup and pay online. It also has a 5-article blog, an Instagram feed, a photo gallery and lots of animations, in a warm and modern look.
audience: Local customers in and around Indiranagar, Bengaluru, mostly on phones, who want to check the menu, hours and location and pre-order coffee for pickup.
standards: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file; CDN libraries allowed; no build step
Mobile-first: viewport meta tag, base styles for small screens, min-width media queries for larger ones
Warm and modern look: warm palette, clean type, generous spacing
Readable text contrast and tap targets of at least 44px
rules: Never invent facts: any missing business detail is shown as a visibly marked placeholder, for example [PLACEHOLDER: opening hours]
No secret keys, tokens or passwords in the file; only a clearly marked placeholder for a public payment key
Placeholder images and blog text must be labelled as placeholders, not presented as real
done_when: The site is one HTML file with inline or CDN CSS and JS, one page with section anchors and a nav linking to them
A menu section lists items grouped by category, each with a ₹ price or a marked price placeholder
An opening hours section shows hours for every day of the week, real or marked placeholder
A location section names Indiranagar, Bengaluru and has an address (or marked placeholder) and a map link or embed
A pre-order for pickup form lets the visitor choose items and quantities, enter name, phone and pickup time, and shows a running total
The pre-order flow includes an online payment step using a CDN checkout or payment link, with a marked placeholder key and no secrets
A blog section contains 5 articles, each with a title and body text, labelled as placeholder content where facts are unknown
An Instagram feed section is present, with a marked placeholder handle and a grid of posts or an embed
A photo gallery section has at least 6 images, marked as placeholders where real photos are missing
Animations are present: scroll-reveal on sections, hover or press effects on buttons and cards, and a hero entrance, with a prefers-reduced-motion rule
The file has a viewport meta tag and CSS written mobile-first with min-width media queries
Every missing business fact appears on the page as a visibly marked placeholder
open_inputs: Full street address and map location
Pickup time rules and slot length
Payment provider choice and its public key (or payment link)
Real photos for the gallery and hero
Blog topics, or real article text for the 5 articles
Brand colours, logo and any brand voice notes
